review_candidates.title: Content Marketeer
review_candidates.description: Content Marketeer Turn real technology and extraordinary access into stories people remember. Eindhoven, Strijp-T | On-site | Full-time Picture yourself a few months in You are at a Formula 2 race weekend, close to the cars and the engineers. Sorama is bringing industrial prospects together for a Sound of Success session. You are not there to collect paddock shots for a generic highlight reel. You are looking for the real story: what the technology reveals, what the people working with it can explain and why that matters to the audience we want to reach. Before the event, you worked with Sales and the team to understand its theme and audience. You shaped the invitation, prepared content for the right channels and made a practical plan for what to capture. On site, you get the interview, the demonstration and the detail that makes the story credible. You know when to put the camera down and ask a better question. Back in Eindhoven, you turn that material into a sharp short video, a clear post and a story Sales can use in follow-up. You use AI tools to transcribe, find useful moments, develop drafts and adapt formats faster. But you check every claim, protect what cannot be shared and make the final choices yourself. A week later, the content is still useful: not just a record of the event, but part of a recognisable Sorama story. That is how content works within our BITSER approach: technology, customer problems, elite sport and human relationships come together in programmes that build recognition and open relevant conversations. Your craft is to make those connections visible without letting the spectacle drown out the substance. The role Sorama makes sound visible. Our work spans industrial inspection, sports and venues, design and cities. We have access to real technology, real customer challenges and distinctive partnerships, including MP Motorsport and PSV. We are looking for a hands-on content marketeer who can find the story in that material and produce it consistently across channels. This is primarily a content creation role. You write, edit and publish. You can turn complex input from Sales, Product and R&D into accurate, accessible stories, and you can take a piece of content from rough material to finished output. You use new AI tools extensively to improve your workflow and output, without confusing speed with quality or inventing facts, results or visuals. What you will do Create and edit strong written and visual content: social posts, short videos, event stories, customer cases and reusable assets for Sorama channels. Find the human and technical story by interviewing colleagues, partners and customers and checking the facts with the people who know them. Capture or coordinate real material at customer locations, workshops and selected elite-sports or motorsport moments, then turn it into useful content before, during and after. Use AI tools confidently for research support, transcription, editing, drafting, repurposing and workflow efficiency; verify the output and keep Sorama’s voice unmistakably human. Work closely with Sales on the content that supports focused regional outreach and Sound of Success programmes, while Sales owns prospecting and closing. Build an achievable publishing rhythm, maintain an organised content pipeline and learn from reach, engagement and relevant inbound interest. Guard brand consistency, permissions and factual accuracy. Make sure every story shows what Sorama actually did and why it matters. What success looks like Sorama publishes a steady stream of distinctive, accurate content that people recognise as ours. Real projects and partnerships become repeatable stories, not one-off posts. Sound of Success and other BITSER programmes have useful content before, during and after each moment. Sales and recruiting can draw on clear, credible assets, and your AI-assisted workflow makes production faster without making the work generic. You may be a fit if You have created and published content you can show us. You can write clearly in English, edit short-form video or visual content, and make complex subjects understandable without overselling them. You are hands-on, organised and comfortable moving between an industrial customer story and a sports or motorsport setting. You actively experiment with AI tools and can explain where they save time, where they do not and how you check the result. You enjoy working with technical and commercial colleagues and are willing to join selected events outside normal office hours. A perfect industry CV is less important than strong work, sound judgment and the drive to keep improving. Why Sorama You will have unusual access to deep technology, real-world applications and elite-sports partnerships, with the room to shape how those stories are told. You will work from our Strijp-T base in Eindhoven with colleagues across Sales, Product and R&D. The role is full-time and on-site, with selected travel and events. We offer a salary between €3500 - €4500 a month, 25 vacation days with the option to purchase more, plus a laptop, phone and mobility arrangement. Interested? Send your CV, a short motivation and two or three pieces of work you made to recruitment@sorama.eu. Tell us what you personally created, how you used AI or other tools, and why you chose that story and format. We would rather see your thinking and finished work than a long list of platforms.

review_candidates.description: Application Support Consultant £40,000 to £45,000 | Remote, UK Please note: You must currently be based in the UK to be considered for this role. This role does not offer sponsorship. Some support roles are about resetting passwords and getting through a ticket queue. This one is about understanding how a business actually works. MCS Group is partnering with an established software company as it grows its UK customer support team. Its ERP platform helps businesses manage everything from finance and stock control through to CRM, eCommerce, reporting, warehousing and supply chain operations. That makes the problems more interesting. You could be investigating why a financial report doesn't look right in the morning, tracing data through an integration after lunch, and helping a customer understand a stock or warehouse process later that day. This is not a general IT support or service desk position. You'll be trusted to investigate issues properly, understand the wider business process and guide customers towards the right solution. What will you be doing? Taking ownership of technical and functional customer queries Investigating issues across ERP and wider business applications Using SQL and database investigation to understand application and data issues Reproducing problems and working through the likely root cause Troubleshooting integrations and data flows between systems Reviewing reports, files, application data and logs Investigating issues across finance, sales, purchasing, stock, warehousing and other business processes Explaining technical information clearly to non-technical customers Documenting findings and creating useful internal knowledge Working closely with support, customer success and development teams Building a strong understanding of how customers use the software day-to-day What we're looking for We're deliberately being quite specific with this search. Previous ERP or business application support experience is a requirement for this role. We're looking for someone who already understands what it's like to support software sitting across multiple areas of a business and who can investigate beyond the initial symptom reported by a customer. To be considered, you must have: Current UK residency Commercial experience supporting ERP, accounting, finance, business management or similarly complex enterprise software Hands-on experience using SQL and relational databases to investigate application or data issues Experience troubleshooting complex application issues through to resolution Experience with APIs, system integrations or data flows An understanding of business processes such as finance, invoicing, purchasing, sales, stock, inventory, warehousing or reporting Experience dealing directly with customers or business users The ability to investigate whether an issue relates to the application, database, integration, configuration or user process Strong written and verbal communication skills A logical and structured approach to troubleshooting If your experience is predominantly desktop support, hardware, infrastructure or general IT service desk support without ERP/business application experience, this position is unlikely to be the right fit. Technical Experience Alongside your ERP or business application background, we're particularly interested in experience across: SQL Server or MySQL SQL scripting and database investigation REST or SOAP APIs Postman or SoapUI JSON or XML FTP / SFTP CSV files and Excel Third-party software integrations CRM eCommerce Warehouse or logistics systems Business intelligence and reporting Accounting or financial systems You don't need experience with this company's specific ERP platform. Full product training will be provided. Why consider it? This is an opportunity to move beyond surface-level support and work with software that sits at the centre of how customers run their businesses. You'll have genuine ownership of customer problems and exposure to a broad technical environment covering ERP, SQL, databases, integrations, APIs, reporting and business processes. You'll also receive full training on the company's own platform, with ongoing opportunities to continue developing your technical and commercial knowledge. The package includes: £40,000 to £45,000 salary Fully remote working within the UK 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays Private healthcare Employer pension contribution Exercise and wellbeing reimbursement Full product training Ongoing training and career development If you're already supporting ERP or complex business software, are comfortable investigating issues using SQL and enjoy getting under the bonnet of applications to understand what's really going wrong, I'd be keen to speak with you. How to Apply To apply for this role, submit your CV via the application form provided. Alternatively, to speak in absolute confidence about this opportunity, please contact Jack Tyrrell via j.tyrrell@mcsgroup.jobs Disclaimer If you have a disability which means you require assistance at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us directly to discuss. We are committed to providing equality of opportunity to all. Please note, this position is open to candidates currently based in the UK only. We are receiving an exceptionally high number of applications and will be unable to shortlist candidates who do not meet the location and technical requirements outlined above. Due to the volume of applications, we may be unable to provide individual feedback. We thank you in advance for your understanding.

review_candidates.title: Airlines Sales Executive
review_candidates.description: Estamos en la búsqueda de un Ejecutivo de Ventas a tiempo completo, basado en Barcelona, para representar comercialmente a las aerolíneas de nuestro portfolio. Es una posición de carácter híbrido con disponibilidad para viajar, cuyo candidato ideal debe cumplir el siguiente perfil: Imprescindible residencia en BARCELONA (por favor, no aplicar de no poseer este requisito) Alta aptitud de comunicación, negociación, influencia y networking. Capacidad para generar leads y cerrar ventas. Competencia para resolución de conflictos. Buenas habilidades de organización y gestión del tiempo. Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y como parte de un equipo. Conocimiento de las regulaciones, políticas y procedimientos de la industria aérea. Dominio del software Microsoft Office y CRM. Necesario dominio del idioma Inglés (requisito indispensable) Responsabilidades: - Desarrollar e implementar estrategias integrales de ventas para aumentar los ingresos y la participación de mercado de las aerolíneas que representamos. - Identificar y buscar nuevas oportunidades de negocio a través de prospección, llamadas en frío y networking. - Mantener relaciones sólidas con los clientes existentes (agencias de viajes, operadores turísticos, mayoristas, OTA) y brindar un servicio al cliente excepcional. - Elaborar y presentar propuestas e informes de ventas a la alta dirección. - Conocer la industria y mantenerse actualizado sobre las tendencias y actividades de la competencia para tomar decisiones comerciales informadas. - Asistir a conferencias, ferias comerciales y otros eventos para promocionar las aerolíneas y generar posicionamiento de marca. Si te apasionan las ventas y la industria aérea, y posees las habilidades y la experiencia necesaria, te animamos a postularte para el puesto de Ejecutivo de Ventas con nosotros. Se ruega que las aplicaciones sean únicamente de candidatos con residencia en BARCELONA. Otras solicitudes serán descartadas automáticamente.

Our platform offers a comprehensive reservation system, enabling businesses to efficiently manage bookings, client databases, and schedules. With over 6,000 salons already benefitting from our services, we are committed to enhancing customer experience and operational efficiency for our partners. We are looking for a reliable and organized Administrative Assistant to support our daily office operations and HR activities. In this role, you will ensure the smooth running of the office while assisting with administrative processes, employee support, and internal coordination. What awaits you? Provide administrative support for business activities and internal processes. Receive, register, and manage incoming and outgoing shipments (mail, packages, courier services). Support and assist onboarding and pre-onboarding activities for new employees (documentation, training coordination, access setup), HR administration and operation. Coordinate internal meetings, company events, other events and visits. Taking care of the operations of the office, ordering refreshments, office supplies and others. Who are we looking for? SZÉP card credits with access to a wide network of partner facilities. Monthly credit increasing with each year at the company. Multisport Pass – Platinum subscription. Annual contribution of 18,000 HUF (net) towards dioptric glasses. Employee VIP pricing in Notino’s online store. A dynamic, supportive team where your ideas and input truly matter.

review_candidates.title: Account Manager to Avinode Group
review_candidates.description: We are seeking a highly-motivated Account Manager responsible for delivering on revenue targets by managing existing accounts in your territory. You are responsible for expansion and advocacy across your portfolio. You work close with our Customer Success Managers to drive value and retain customers. What you will do • Develop an understanding of your customers’ business drivers and challenges. • Establish a strategic advisor relationship with your customers within various departments to communicate and deliver value. • Proactive in offering of strategic insights and solutions to solve the customers challenges within the Charter Sales offering. • Identify opportunities or further scope out the opportunities uncovered by CSMs to expand the scope of all Avinode Group’s products for your accounts. • Communicate and share customer needs and pain points internally with Product to solve issues and influence future product roadmap enhancements. • Stay up to date on industry trends by attending events, trade shows, and conferences. • Consistently log your activities & tasks and keep track of sales opportunities in Avinode Group’s CRM system (Salesforce). What we are looking for We are looking for someone who is confident without being arrogant, hardworking while still knowing how to have fun, and passionate about delivering today while building for tomorrow. You embrace a dynamic environment and an industry where change is the only constant. You are highly motivated, entrepreneurial and energetic, and thrive in a high-performing organization. You bring excellent problem-solving and negotiating skills, combined with an analytical and critical mindset, using data and input from members and the team to inform your recommendations and assessments. You are never satisfied with the status quo and constantly look to improve both yourself and the business. You are curious, eager to experiment and try new approaches and tools. An effective communicator with strong influencing skills, you build consensus, bring people with you and master change management. We believe you will thrive in this role if you bring • You have 3+ years relevant experience as a seasoned sales and customer success professional in SaaS B2B sales and customer success. • You have an understanding of the complexity of the charter sales operations of an operator or broker. • You are knowledgeable about all our Charter Sales products and keep up to date on product enhancements. • You have a Bachelor’s degree or experience commensurate with job expectations for this position. • You demonstrate proficiency with CRM platforms, AI-powered productivity tools, and other business applications to effectively manage and improve day-to-day efficiency • You are a people person and you are not afraid to build strong relationships by talking to people in person or over the phone. • You have a proven track record in developing and executing strategic account plans, negotiating contracts, and identifying expansion opportunities. • Able to travel 30% of the time domestically and internationally. What do we offer you? We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard. • Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations. • Competitive salary and benefits • Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important. • Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings. We want to support your development and dreams. About Avinode Group Avinode Group, owned by CAMP, offers a fully connected suite of essential B2B software to enable Business Aviation professionals through the entire workflow of managing, sourcing, and booking aircraft. Founded in the heart of Sweden in 2002, we support around 2,000 companies globally. Our essential tools are designed to minimize stress and maximize profit for brokers and operators. The suite includes the world’s leading sourcing platform for air charter, making it easy to find aircraft, book trips, and market aircraft globally. Air charter operators and flight departments are provided with a fully cloud-based fleet management system to make flight operations smoother. Our customers can rely on a hassle-free process from quoting to booking and paying with a fully integrated payment solution. With 150+ Noders spread between Sweden and the US, our flexible and collaborative culture empowers everyone to come forward with new ideas, try them out, make some mistakes, and initiate dialogue. Avinode Group seeks candidates who thrive on exciting assignments and can collaboratively work alongside other intelligent, humorous, and dedicated co-workers. Our roots are firmly planted in our core values, which inspire us daily to exceed expectations. Avinode Group is an equal opportunity employer and cares about having the best people for the job. We care about your skills and who you are as a person. Want more details? Discover the value our essentials bring to our customers every day. Assignment details Employment type: Full-time. Location: Gothenburg, Sweden (hybrid). Want to join the Avinode Group crew? Sounds like a great fit? You can find more fun facts about our Noders, that’s what we call ourselves, and our culture on our website . Please apply through the apply button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications by email. Selections will run continuously, so please do not wait to apply. In this process, Avinode Group collaborates with A-hub. If you have any questions about the process, please contact Filippa Stenberg at filippa.stenberg@a-hub.se .

review_candidates.title: Account Executive
review_candidates.description: Are you relationship-driven and excited about building client connections and driving sales growth? Do you thrive on uncovering new opportunities and maximizing revenue? FocusEconomics is a leading provider of economic intelligence reports, data solutions and a business intelligence platform for senior executives in multinational companies, financial institutions and governmental organizations. We are seeking a highly motivated, results-driven business-to-business sales executive to join our commercial team in Barcelona. Responsibilities Generate and qualify new leads through research, networking and social selling. Manage automated prospecting tools (e.g. Enginy), ensuring all allocated resources are fully utilized. Build a strong pipeline of relationships with C-level decision-makers. Identify business drivers and match the optimal solution to each customer. Manage full sales cycles from quoting through negotiation to close, including writing outstanding business proposals. Convert qualified prospects into clients and grow those accounts through upsell. Create and execute account strategies for new and existing clients. Keep customers and prospects engaged through frequent and timely follow-up. Work with the Customer Success Manager on the handover of accounts into managed renewal. Forecast and monitor performance against key sales indicators. Requirements Degree in Business, Economics or a related field. 3-4 years of experience in sales, preferably in a B2B environment; SaaS experience is an advantage. Proven track record of quota-carrying sales, with the ability to drive the sales process from plan to close. Strong proficiency in written and spoken English and Spanish. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong listening, negotiation and presentation abilities. Ability to communicate, present and influence at all levels, including executives and C-level managers. Familiarity with Salesforce, LinkedIn and campaign platforms. Driven, client-focused and highly motivated, with a strong sense of initiative and the ability to work independently while staying goal-oriented. Experience selling solutions to Fortune 500 companies is an advantage. Knowledge of global economic developments is an advantage. Experience using Salesforce and/other comparable CRM tools Our Offer Hybrid work model with the flexibility to work remotely for up to six weeks annually. Flexible working hours. Annual learning budget provided for professional development. Optional private health insurance with Sanitas. Office perks include complimentary fruits and coffee. Enjoy an international and multicultural workplace environment. Participate in regular team events and social gatherings, including seasonal celebrations. Office in sunny Barcelona city center. About us Based in Barcelona, Spain, FocusEconomics is a leading provider of economic intelligence through reports, data solutions, and a business intelligence platform. Our clients include senior executives from multinational and national companies, government organizations, and think tanks. To deliver the latest economic forecasts, we rely on an extensive global network of analysts from leading investment banks, consultancies, and national banks worldwide.
